question.text: What is the concept of 'manipulative or deceptive device or contrivance' as used in the PFUTP Regulations?

answer.text: It refers only to electronic trading tools that give unfair speed advantage
It refers to any device, scheme, or artifice used in connection with the issue, purchase, or sale of any security to manipulate or deceive, in contravention of SEBI Act or rules/regulations
It covers only false financial statements issued by companies
It applies only to derivatives and structured products

explanation.text: The Logic: The PFUTP Regulations prohibit the use or employment of any manipulative or deceptive device or contrivance, or any device, scheme or artifice to defraud, in connection with the issue, purchase or sale of any security listed or proposed to be listed, in contravention of the SEBI Act or the rules or regulations made thereunder. The Trap: Options A, C and D each narrow the prohibition to a single category (electronic tools, false financial statements, or derivatives/structured products). The regulation's language is broad and is not limited to any one such category. Note: Source-backed to NISM-Series-III-A workbook (Dec 2025), page 145.
